prompts.Move: Use case: stylized-concept. Production pixel-art animation sprite sheet for DEAD WOODS. Reference images 1 and 2 are the exact approved Eli Varga idle SE (front three-quarter down-right) and NE (rear three-quarter up-right). Preserve character identity, realistic wiry adult proportions, small head, cap and centred sand accent band, short sandy beard, blue-grey zipped running jacket, dark navy long running trousers, grey trail shoes, olive hydration vest with matched chest bottles and pouches and centred pistol holster. Match pixel-cluster shading and muted palette exactly; add genuine source detail suitable for a 100-pixel tall figure in 128x128 logical cells. Everything symmetric or centred, no watch, sling or asymmetric gear. Fixed isometric 2:1 camera, no perspective or camera rotation. Transparent background, no shadows, gridlines, labels, text or numbers. REGULAR 4 columns x 4 rows grid of equal square logical 128x128 cells; each cell centred at x64, feet anchor y112. Standing figure 100 logical pixels tall; keep proportions consistent across poses, never enlarge shorter poses. Four separate discrete animation poses across each row. Full sprite within its own cell, generous clear gutters, no touching neighbouring sprites. Holstered pistol stays in holster except shot. Hands empty except specified actions. Rows precisely: row1 walk SE, row2 walk NE, row3 run SE, row4 run NE. Each walk row: frame0 right foot forward contact; frame1 passing; frame2 left foot forward contact; frame3 passing with opposite leg. Opposing natural arm swing. Run: longer stride, ten degree forward lean, elbows bent ninety degrees, airborne stride on frames1 and3, visibly faster than walk. All characters face screen-right; front in rows1/3, back in rows2/4. Same scale, camera and gear as references. Smooth coherent 4-frame cycles.
